lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately eight vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible. Each column contains between 4 and 6 distinct blobs, forming a repetitive grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: The circular blobs are aligned on vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity that run perpendicular to the body axis, creating a series of vertical anchor nodes for the pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the longitudinal axis of the flank. These features are defined by high-intensity highlights on their dorsal edges and sharp shadow gradients on their ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots, primarily clustered towards the trailing edge and lower half of the fin's visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin displays a high concentration of small, bright spots along its anterior margin and distal tip, contrasting with the larger, more orderly blobs on the main flank.
